text:
```yaml
name: ESLint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  eslint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint
```
